_comment: Curated gap: pre-installed slot polarities for Warframes AND weapons (regular slot polarities, plus the Aura, Exilus and Stance slot polarity). Not derivable from any official source — the official Public Export files and the droptables carry no slot/aura polarity data (verified against all of them). Sourced from the community-maintained item snapshot (polarity lines only, junk filtered; see catalog-workspace/community-polarity-only/README.md). Supersedes the name-keyed warframe_polarities.json: keys are now item uniqueNames so the assembler matches under any item locale.
_format: Keys are item uniqueNames (exactly the built catalog uniqueName field; stable across all item locales). Values: { polarities: [regular slots], aura? (Warframe), exilusPolarity? (Warframe Exilus adapter slot), stancePolarity? (weapon stance slot) }. Fields are omitted when the source carries none. _-prefixed keys are ignored by the CatalogBuilder.
